dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell (non-GCB) phenotype by the Hans algorithm

stage_iii.quote: Lugano stage III with splenic involvement (IIIS)

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: the spleen is a lymphatic organ, so splenic involvement is annotated 'S' and does not make this stage IV

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: The 11 cm retroperitoneal mass meets the >=10 cm definition of bulky disease

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: extranodal sites >1 = 0 (spleen is a lymphatic organ, not an extranodal site)

mol_de_not_dh.quote: FISH is negative for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, so this is NOT double-hit/triple-hit disease

prog_ipi_3.note: Lists three scoring factors but miscounts total as IPI 2.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI = 3 points: age >60 (1), LDH above ULN (1), stage III (1)

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Six cycles of polatuzumab vedotin + R-CHP (pola-R-CHP) every 21 days
tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.note: Curative pola-R-CHP x6, though polatuzumab is misdosed at 1.45 mg/kg.

tx_pola_preferred.quote: NCCN lists pola-R-CHP as a preferred regimen for previously untreated DLBCL with IPI 2-5

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.note: EOT Deauville 4-5 leads to biopsy and salvage; ISRT to residual bulk not considered.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I would not substitute DA-R-EPOCH-R (no MYC/BCL2 rearrangement)

mn_dose_reduced_initial.note: Polatuzumab 1.45 mg/kg is an unintended underdose, but no dose-reduced regimen is recommended.

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: resolved HBV infection, no antiviral prophylaxis required

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: hepatitis B DNA quantitation and continued HBsAg/anti-HBc/anti-HBs monitoring
hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.note: Orders HBV DNA and monitoring but ALT monitoring is implicit only (CMP each cycle).

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: resolved HBV infection, no antiviral prophylaxis required

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: CNS prophylaxis is indicated and a brain MRI is required before treatment

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: give intrathecal cytarabine plus methotrexate (with dexamethasone) with each of the 6 systemic cycles

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Deauville 1-3 is complete metabolic response (Lugano CR)

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 (partial metabolic response) requires biopsy of the residual FDG-avid site

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: allopurinol 300 mg daily starting 2 days before cycle 1 and continuing through cycle 1, oral/IV hydration

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC on day 2 of every cycle

work_echo_reviewed.quote: his baseline echocardiogram is normal (LVEF 58%, GLS -20%), so full-dose doxorubicin is appropriate

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit enough for full-dose curative therapy.

miss_hbv_dna.quote: No quantitative HBV DNA and no repeat HBsAg/anti-HBc/anti-HBs after 2026-09-03
